phases.title: Survival
phases.goal: Read both kana scripts and handle basic greetings, numbers, and polite set phrases.
can: Read and write all 46 hiragana and their dakuten/handakuten variants
Read all 46 katakana for loanwords like コーヒー and ホテル
Use core greetings: おはようございます, こんにちは, ありがとうございます, すみません
Count 1–10,000 and tell the hour with 〜時
Form the polite Noun + です sentence (これはりんごです)
Recognize the three particles は, を, and に in simple sentences
phases.daily: 15 min kana drills, 10 min greeting/number flashcards, 5 min writing practice

phases.title: Foundation
phases.goal: Build polite everyday sentences with verbs, adjectives, and essential particles.
can: Conjugate verbs into ます / ました / ません / ませんでした
Use い-adjectives and な-adjectives (暑い, 静かな) and their negatives
Handle particles で (means/place) and と (with/and) correctly
Express existence with あります and います
Ask questions with 何, どこ, いつ, だれ, いくら
Start learning your first ~100 kanji and their basic readings
phases.daily: 20 min verb/adjective conjugation, 15 min kanji, 10 min speaking aloud

phases.title: Core Structures
phases.goal: Link ideas fluidly with the て-form and master the plain (casual) style.
can: Use the て-form for requests (〜てください) and progressives (〜ています)
Switch between polite and plain forms (食べる / 食べない / 食べた)
Express desire with 〜たい and give reasons with から and ので
Build relative clauses that modify nouns (昨日買った本)
Use the たら / ば / と / なら conditionals for 'if/when'
Read roughly 300 kanji and simple graded readers
phases.daily: 25 min grammar patterns, 15 min kanji, 15 min graded reading, 10 min listening

phases.title: Fluency
phases.goal: Handle nuanced grammar and hold natural conversations on everyday topics.
can: Use giving/receiving verbs あげる, くれる, もらう and their favor forms
Form and understand the potential, passive, and causative voices
Express obligation (〜なければならない), permission (〜てもいい), and advice (〜ほうがいい)
Report speech and thought with 〜と思う and 〜と言う
Understand plain-form casual conversation between friends
Read around 1,000 kanji, approaching JLPT N3 level
phases.daily: 30 min conversation/shadowing, 20 min kanji + reading, 15 min podcasts or drama

phases.title: Mastery
phases.goal: Operate in formal, professional, and native-level contexts with keigo and nuance.
can: Use 尊敬語 and 謙譲語 keigo appropriately in business settings
Understand and produce conjecture forms (〜でしょう, 〜かもしれない, 〜そうだ, 〜ようだ)
Read newspapers, novels, and business email fluently (2,000+ kanji, JLPT N1)
Follow fast native speech, including regional accents and slang
Write structured essays and formal correspondence
Discuss abstract topics like politics, culture, and work with precision
phases.daily: 30 min native media (news/novels), 20 min writing, 15 min keigo and nuance study
